_about: First-call tool selection cases. Each ask is phrased the way a user would type it and never names a tool. `accept` is every tool whose first call is a reasonable start; a case fails only when the first call is outside that set or no tool is called. Edit the set deliberately: a case that accepts everything measures nothing.

cases.ask: Will this model train on my 24 GB card at batch 16, or do I need something bigger?
What's the cheapest GPU I can fine-tune this on without running out of memory?
How big a batch can I push on an A100 80GB with this before it falls over?
Roughly what will one training run of this cost me before I reserve anything?
My job just died with 'CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.50 GiB; 1.2 GiB free; 21.3 GiB reserved by PyTorch'. What happened and what should I change?
Training crashed with an out-of-memory error even though nvidia-smi said there was plenty free. Here's the message: 'reserved but unallocated memory is large'. Why?
I just resized the embedding to add 2,000 new tokens and tied the head. Did I break anything before I kick off training?
I changed the LoRA target modules and bumped the number of heads in the config. Sanity-check the edit before I launch.
I stretched the RoPE scaling to get 32k context. Is that change going to bite me, and how much more memory does it need?
I want to run this with tensor parallel 4 and pipeline parallel 2 on 8 H100s. Is that split even valid?
With 4 pipeline stages, is one stage going to be way slower than the others?
Is there a better way to split the layers across my pipeline stages than splitting them evenly?
Before I start serving: vllm serve with --tensor-parallel-size 2 --max-model-len 65536 on two L40S. Will that work?
How many concurrent requests at 8k context can I serve on one H100 before the KV cache runs out?
I'm going to run the Q4_K_M GGUF of this with llama.cpp on a 16 GB card. Anything wrong with that setup?
Our SGLang deployment answers oddly compared to the reference. Could the launch config, sampler defaults or chat template be the problem?
Do any of our training scripts download Hugging Face models without pinning a specific commit?
Audit the Dockerfile and the YAML configs: are the model downloads reproducible, or will they silently pick up whatever is on main?
Did anything change upstream in Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct since we pinned it last month?
Has the chat template or the generation config of the model we depend on been modified recently?
Is the latest revision of the base model we fine-tune from a breaking change for us?
Have we trained this exact architecture before here? What happened last time?
What peak memory did we actually measure the last time this structure ran in our org?
Write up the pre-check card for this change the way the CI bot would post it on the pull request.
I'm about to open a PR with this model change. Give me the summary reviewers will want to see: what changed, what it needs, what it costs.
The static parse of my model looks incomplete. Get me the real graph by actually running the module.
My layers are built in a for loop in __init__, so the reader misses some. Can you get the true layer list?
Is this model ready to train? Give me a verdict.
Run the design rules over it: head-dim divisibility, norm ordering, dropout ranges, that kind of thing.
Will this pass the Neurarch check in CI as it stands?
What is this model and where does its parameter budget live?
Which five layers have the most parameters?
Where are all the convolution layers?
Which layers under encoder.layer.3 are frozen?
Show me everything about the attention layer: its params, shapes and what it connects to.
If I halve the width of the mlp layer, what else breaks?
What is downstream of the patch embedding, and which of those layers would need their weights rebuilt if I change it?
Something's off with the attention block. Tell me exactly what to change to fix it.
How does this compare with a standard ViT-B/16? Pull up the reference.
Find me a small open model on the Hub with a similar architecture that I could start from.
My dataset has 1000 classes at 384x384 images. Does that fit what this model accepts, or will the first batch crash?
It doesn't fit on one GPU. What's the simplest two-card setup that would hold it?
